goal: Let each session open an owner-only architecture view focused on the cards its worktree changed, planned or read; group worktrees under their repo's main folder, which owns the one map.
constraints: Do not edit scripts/hooks/, scripts/permit.*, schemas/denylist.default or .claude/settings.json.
A session view answers 404 to anyone but its owner: loopback requests count as the machine owner; tailnet requests are checked with tailscale whois.
Worktrees reuse their main folder's board; they are not mapped separately when the main folder has a board.
Defaults: read-only files count (weakest signal); a finished session keeps a read-only view until its worktree is gone; no sharing.

non_goals.description: No sharing links or teammate access.
No change to the mapper prompt or board.json schema.
No migration or deletion of existing per-worktree boards.

acceptance.criterion: board.py list groups worktrees under their main folder, and focus returns changed, planned and read signals for a session
Session routes answer 404 to a non-owner and serve the owner
The sidebar shows main folders with worktree tasks beneath them, and the session view folds untouched cards
A stopped job's process is gone when stop returns
